scenes.name: ROOTS CANCEL
lines: Take three integer rays: a is one, b is one plus i, c is one plus j.
取三条整数射线：a = 1，b = 1 + i，c = 1 + j。
One side alone leaks a root: the cosine of a and b is one over root two.
单看一条边就漏出根号：a 与 b 的夹角余弦是 1/√2。
Flip a to minus a, the same ray, and that cosine flips sign.
把 a 换成 −a，射线没变，这个余弦却变了号。
Walk the loop instead: each corner is met twice, roots and signs cancel, and the Bargmann number B is one quarter.
沿环路走一圈：每个顶点碰到两次，根号与符号全部成对消去，巴格曼环路数 B = ¼。

scenes.name: THE CLOSING LAW
lines: Put the inner products in a Gram matrix: determinant one, over squared lengths four.
把内积排成格拉姆矩阵：行列式为 1，模方之积为 4。
So the closing number is one quarter: one plus two B, minus the three kappas.
于是闭合数是 ¼：等于 1 + 2B 减去三条边的 κ。
Lean checks this exact value: no sine, no cosine, no root.
Lean 内核检验这个精确值：没有正弦，没有余弦，没有根号。

scenes.name: NEVER NEGATIVE
lines: Why never negative? Stack the rays as columns of a four by three matrix.
为什么永不为负？把三条射线排成 4×3 矩阵的三列。
For one plus i, one plus j, one plus k, the four minors are one, minus one, one, one.
对 1 + i、1 + j、1 + k，四个三阶子式依次是 1、−1、1、1。
Their squares add to four; over eight, the closing number is one half.
它们的平方和是 4；除以 8，闭合数是 ½。
Lean checks the general fact: for any three nonzero integer quaternions, it is never negative.
Lean 内核检验一般事实：任取三枚非零整四元数，闭合数都不为负。

scenes.name: ONE GREAT CIRCLE
lines: Now one great circle: a is one, b is two plus i, and c, b a-bar b, is three plus four i.
现在取同一条大圆：a = 1，b = 2 + i，c = b·ā·b = 3 + 4i。
The kappas are four fifths, four fifths, nine twenty-fifths; B is twelve twenty-fifths; the closing number is zero.
Lean checks that every such doubling triad closes to exactly zero.
Lean 内核检验：每一组这样的倍增三元组，闭合数都恰为零。
With b one plus two i, B turns negative: the loop keeps a sign the sides forget.
取 b = 1 + 2i，B 变成负数：环路保住了三条边丢掉的符号。

scenes.name: ARC DOUBLING
lines: Zero on the circle locks an integer law: the doubled overlap is two kappa minus one, squared.
大圆上的零锁定一条整系数定律：倍增后的重叠等于 (2κ − 1)²。
Four fifths goes to nine twenty-fifths, nine tenths to sixteen twenty-fifths, one half to zero.
Lean checks this doubling law for every pair of nonzero integer quaternions.
Lean 内核对每一对非零整四元数检验这条倍增律。

scenes.name: SPHERICAL EXCESS
lines: Back to the quarter triad: divide by the two side spreads at a corner.
回到闭合数为 ¼ 的三元组：除以一个顶点两条邻边的展开度。
At a it is one, a right angle; at b and c, two thirds, above the flat one half: that is the excess.
顶点 a 处得 1，是直角；b、c 处得 2/3，高于平面上的 ½：多出的就是球面角盈。
Lean checks the rational sine law: each vertex spread over its opposite side spread is four thirds here.
Lean 内核检验有理正弦律：每个顶点展开度除以对边展开度，这里都是 4/3。
And the right-angle law: one quarter is a half times a half.
还有直角律：¼ = ½ × ½。

scenes.name: FOUR TRIADS
lines: Four triads: the doubled arc closes at zero, the half steps at one quarter.
四组三元组：倍增弧闭合于 0，正交半步闭合于 ¼。
The equal-sided triad gives one half, its vertex spreads eight ninths, not the flat three quarters.
等边三元组给出 ½，顶点展开度是 8/9，而不是平面上的 ¾。
Three orthogonal rays reach the largest value, one, with three right angles.
三条两两正交的射线达到最大值 1，三个角都是直角。
Cast onto the reals, it becomes a product of sine squares: classical trigonometry is its shadow.
投到实数上，闭合数化为正弦平方之积：古典三角学只是它的影子。

scenes.name: CLOSED IN FRACTIONS
lines: Spherical trigonometry, closed in integers and fractions, and checked by Lean.
球面三角学，用整数与分数闭合，并由 Lean 内核检验。
